dimensions.note: Username and password are vault-wired method inputs marked sensitive; they travel only in an Authorization or X-Auth-Token header, never in a URL, log, error, output or stored state (tested; live secret scan of 343 files: 0 hits). TLS is strict only: insecure_skip_verify and allow_insecure_credentials were removed after live showed Deno ignores the switch; ca_pem adds a trusted CA. Session discovery is anonymous (live header capture X2/X3). Residual MEDIUM (astra): a 5xx during session discovery counts as no SessionService, so auto falls back to Basic, still only over verified TLS; recorded in LOGBOOK.
Each method logs once with structured placeholders (origin, system id, action, state); no credential, token, header value or body in log fields.

Typed RedfishError codes: unauthorized, not_found, unreachable, timeout, tls (classified from the fetch cause chain: untrusted CA, CA:TRUE leaf, expired, name mismatch), no_session_service, not_allowed and redfish_failed; messages are fixed text and never echo a body. Every request and body read has an abort deadline. Live T3, T6, A1, A2, U1, U2 and P7 confirm the typed errors.

64 unit tests with a fake fetch and DMTF-shaped synthetic fixtures (no socket): TLS policy, session discovery and logout, Basic fallback, task monitors (completed, 204/404, empty 500), restart transitions, stalled requests and DELETE, cross-origin links, allowable filtering and the plain-object method context. Live on sushy-tools 2.2.0 (emulator only, no real BMC): 21/23 PASS, 0 FAIL, B1/B3 BLOCKED by an emulator limitation where the model correctly refused.

power skips the Reset POST when already in the target state (live P2) and polls to a bounded deadline; restarts follow a task monitor or an observed transition and otherwise succeed with a warning. set_boot is a no-op when already set (live B2), sends If-Match when an ETag exists and reads the override back, refusing when the BMC did not apply it (live B1/B3).

DMTF Redfish service root, Systems collection, ComputerSystem, Reset action and Boot PATCH; @odata.id links are kept on the endpoint origin; requested ResetType is validated against the advertised AllowableValues, filtered to known values.
Each run uses one HttpClient closed in finally; a session is deleted in finally with min(30s, remaining deadline) and skipped with a warning on a cross-origin URI; bodies are capped at 1 MiB.

Manifest has the @randybias/redfish name, Apache-2.0, additionalFiles README.md and LICENSE.txt; README documents strict TLS, ca_pem as an additional trusted CA, the CA:FALSE leaf requirement and auth_mode. No real host, IP or account in code, README or fixtures. Merge-prep fixed two description Lows (power description now three sentences; the TlsPolicy comment no longer says pinned).

Strict zod objects; endpoint is an https origin only; tls_verify is the literal strict; auth_mode is an enum (auto, session, basic); action and boot target are enums; unknown inputs are rejected (live T4/T5).
One state resource, lifetime infinite, garbageCollection 10.
get and sync are READ-ONLY; power and set_boot are DESTRUCTIVE actions. A gone system is recorded as not_found by sync (live S4). There is nothing to create or delete on a BMC.
Before any mutation the model reads the system, checks AllowableValues and the current state, and refuses unknown or disallowed actions with no request sent (live P7).
State is keyed by the canonical origin plus system id, so one definition serves any number of BMCs and systems without collisions.
Stored state holds metadata only (power, boot override, health, allowable resets); no credential or token.
First release; no prior state shape to migrate.
